prompt: In the AWS shared responsibility model, which task is typically the customer’s responsibility for EC2?

options.text: Guest operating system patches and application security
Physical security of AWS data centers

explanation: AWS secures the cloud infrastructure; customers secure what they put in the cloud—including OS, apps, and data for IaaS like EC2.

prompt: Which cloud benefit describes paying only for the resources you consume?

options.text: Capital expense lock-in for five years

explanation: Pay-as-you-go converts many costs to variable operational expense based on usage.

prompt: Which AWS service helps you manage users, groups, and permissions for your AWS account?
explanation: IAM controls authentication and authorization for AWS APIs and resources.

prompt: Amazon EC2 provides:

options.text: Resizable virtual servers in the cloud
A fully managed relational database only

explanation: EC2 is AWS’s core IaaS compute offering for virtual machines.

prompt: Which service is object storage commonly used for backups, static assets, and data lakes?
explanation: S3 stores objects. VPC is networking; IAM is identity; Route 53 is DNS.

prompt: Which tool estimates the cost of a planned AWS architecture before you deploy it?
explanation: The Pricing Calculator models service costs. Macie and Rekognition are ML/security services; Artifact delivers compliance reports.

prompt: An Availability Zone is best described as:

options.text: One or more discrete data centers with redundant power and networking within a Region
A global edge location identical to a full Region

explanation: Regions contain multiple AZs so you can design for high availability inside a geographic area.

prompt: Amazon RDS is primarily:
explanation: RDS manages engines like MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and others with backups and patching options.

prompt: What is the recommended practice for the AWS account root user?

options.text: Enable MFA and avoid using it for everyday tasks
Share the root password with all developers
Create access keys for root and embed them in apps
Disable CloudTrail for the root user

explanation: Root has unrestricted power. Protect it with MFA and prefer IAM users/roles for day-to-day work.

prompt: Which service provides a consolidated view of AWS costs and usage with filters and reports?

options.text: AWS Cost Explorer / Billing & Cost Management tools

explanation: Cost Explorer and related billing consoles help analyze spend. Polly is text-to-speech.

prompt: AWS Lambda lets you run code without provisioning servers. This model is often called:
explanation: Lambda is event-driven serverless compute billed by invocation and duration.

prompt: Which are advantages of cloud computing? Select all that apply.

options.text: Trade capital expense for variable expense
Benefit from massive economies of scale
Require purchasing hardware before every experiment

explanation: Cloud value props include OpEx flexibility, scale pricing, and elasticity. Buying hardware first is the opposite of cloud agility.

prompt: Amazon GuardDuty is best described as:

options.text: A threat detection service that analyzes logs and findings

explanation: GuardDuty continuously monitors for suspicious activity using sources like CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, and DNS logs.

prompt: Amazon VPC enables you to:

options.text: Provision an isolated virtual network for AWS resources
Issue SSL certificates to the public internet as a CA browser root

explanation: VPC is the networking foundation for many AWS resources with subnets, route tables, and gateways.

prompt: The AWS Free Tier typically offers:

options.text: Limited free usage of selected services for new or ongoing eligible accounts
Unlimited enterprise support for every account
Free Dedicated Hosts in every Region forever
Zero charges for all data transfer worldwide with no limits

explanation: Free Tier has service-specific caps and eligibility rules; it is not unlimited everything.

prompt: Amazon CloudFront delivers content to users with lower latency by using:

options.text: Edge locations / a global content delivery network
A single on-premises NAS in one office

explanation: CloudFront caches and serves content from edge locations close to viewers.

prompt: AWS CloudTrail helps with compliance because it:

options.text: Records API activity for auditing who did what, when
Encrypts every EBS volume automatically without configuration options

explanation: CloudTrail provides an audit trail of AWS account activity. Encryption and MFA are separate controls.

prompt: Elasticity in cloud computing means:

options.text: Automatically scaling resources up or down to match demand
Buying maximum capacity for peak forever

explanation: Elastic services adjust capacity so you are not stuck over-provisioned or under-provisioned.

prompt: Amazon SQS is used to:

options.text: Decouple application components with managed message queues

explanation: SQS queues messages between producers and consumers for loose coupling.

prompt: Which statements about AWS pricing are generally true? Select all that apply.

options.text: Many services charge for compute time or capacity used
Data transfer out of AWS often incurs charges
Storage is typically billed by amount stored over time
All AWS services are always free with no limits

explanation: Compute, storage, and transfer are common billable dimensions. Not everything is unlimited free.

prompt: Which support plan feature is associated with higher AWS Support tiers (e.g., Business/Enterprise) compared to Basic?

options.text: Faster response times and broader technical support cases
Removal of the shared responsibility model

explanation: Paid support plans expand channels, response SLAs, and guidance. They do not remove customer security duties.

prompt: Amazon Route 53 provides:

options.text: Scalable DNS and domain registration / routing features
Block storage volumes for EC2 only
Email receiving as SES replacement only

explanation: Route 53 is AWS’s DNS service with health checks and multiple routing policies.

prompt: A hybrid cloud architecture typically means:

options.text: Combining on-premises resources with public cloud services
Using only one laptop offline forever
Running exclusively in a single AZ with no DR plan

explanation: Hybrid connects private data centers or edge sites with cloud VPCs via VPN/Direct Connect and related patterns.

prompt: Which actions improve account security? Select all that apply.

options.text: Follow least privilege in IAM policies
Rotate access keys and prefer roles over long-lived keys
Grant AdministratorAccess to every new hire by default

explanation: MFA, least privilege, and short-lived credentials reduce risk. Blanket admin rights expand blast radius.

prompt: Amazon EBS provides:

options.text: Block-level storage volumes for use with EC2 instances

explanation: EBS volumes attach to instances as durable block devices (with snapshot backups).

prompt: AWS Budgets can notify you when:

options.text: Actual or forecasted costs/usage exceed thresholds you set
An EC2 instance finishes a yum update
Someone opens the AWS console FAQ

explanation: Budgets track cost and usage with alerts via SNS/email integrations.

prompt: Which service is a fully managed NoSQL database commonly cited for single-digit millisecond performance at scale?
explanation: DynamoDB is AWS’s flagship managed NoSQL service. The others are IaC UI, VDI, and mobile testing.

prompt: AWS Artifact is where customers can:

options.text: Download AWS compliance reports and select agreements

explanation: Artifact provides on-demand access to security and compliance documentation from AWS.

prompt: Agility as a cloud benefit mainly refers to:

options.text: Standing up experiments and environments quickly without waiting on hardware lead times
Slower change control than on-premises always
Mandatory multi-year data center builds before coding

explanation: Self-service APIs and global infrastructure let teams iterate faster than traditional procurement cycles.

prompt: Amazon SNS is commonly used to:

options.text: Publish messages to subscribers (email, SMS, SQS, Lambda, etc.)
Manage EC2 hypervisors in the data center

explanation: SNS is a pub/sub notification service. Storage and networking remain separate services.
